messages:
Michelle: Quick heads-up — all-hands this Friday 10:00am PT (same Zoom link). Agenda: 1) brief incident recap + ops learnings, 2) product roadmap highlight: Redwood Optimize launch timeline, 3) policy update: data retention for hosted API, 4) Q&A and open mic. Please drop any questions in this thread or in #all-hands-questions by Thu EOD. Recording and slides to follow. :calendar: :loudspeaker:
Devin: Will you cover the exact SLA wording change in the policy update? need to know for dedicated customers.
Michelle: yes — we'll show the wording and explain impact. high-level: no changes to SLA uptime, but retention controls and export timelines updated.
Raj: does the retention update affect Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments?
Michelle: no — Private stays customer-managed. change only applies to Hosted API data retention defaults; Dedicated customers can opt into custom retention via contract.
Sarah: quick ask — can we include a short FAQ slide for customer-facing teams?
Emily: i'll own the FAQ slide with vendor & support Qs. please DM me urgent ones.
OpsBot: Incident report 2026-03-18-14: brief outage on us-west for ~22m due to worker autoscaler bug. Postmortem draft at https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/2026-03-18-14.
Jorge: For the incident section, can we call out the mitigation steps so eng teams know follow-ups?
Samir: also add the rollout checklist we used so teams can reuse it for deploys.
Michelle: good call — we'll include mitigation timeline + checklist snippet.
Devin: any changes to customer communication templates after the outage?
Sarah: comms team updated the template, will share before the meeting.
Raj: FYI some enterprise customers asked about export SLAs. can we add a slide on export process & timing?
Michelle: added.
Emily: Requesting questions for product roadmap: what's the expected GA date for Optimize? precise week or month helps sales.
Michelle: we'll provide a target month (June) and a canary plan timeline.
Devin: Heads-up — i'll raise a question about pricing model for dedicated burst capacity.
Samir: i'll post the rollout code snippet for the autoscaler in the incident slides.
Sarah: logistics: please be on mute, cameras encouraged, Qs via mic or the Q&A panel. we'll run ~40m + 15m open Q&A.
Michelle: If you cannot attend, RSVP with "regrets" and we will send the recording.
Jorge: can we make the slides accessible (alt text)? product design will help.
Emily: yes — i'll ensure that.
Michelle: Thanks all — see you Friday. action items: Emily to prepare FAQ + accessibility; Samir to add checklist; Sarah to share comms template; Devin to bring pricing questions; Ops to finalize postmortem link.
Sarah: TL;DR takeaways for teams (summarized): - Incident resolved, postmortem in ops docs. - Hosted API retention defaults updating (no SLA uptime change). - Optimize target: June GA window, canary plan included. - Dedicated/private unaffected by retention defaults; export & contract options exist. - Recording + slides posted after meeting.
Devin: +1 for TL;DR.
Michelle: Recording link (will post after meeting) placeholder: https://zoom.redwood/recording/abcd1234
OpsBot: Reminder: please review incident draft and leave comments by Thu 5pm PT.
Emily: dropping a draft FAQ link: https://docs.redwood/internal/all-hands/faq-draft (comments welcome).
Raj: thanks — i'll add export SLA notes.
Samir: thanks team. :thumbsup:
Michelle: Closing thread — please add late questions in #all-hands-questions or DM me.
